nodes.label: AshaSathi Splash Screen Brand Logo
nodes.description: Primary splash screen asset showing the AshaSathi brand wordmark in bold green (#2E8B3A / #34A853-range) letters on a plain white background. The letter 'H' in 'ASHA' is visually replaced by a house icon (roof + window grid) forming an integrated logomark. 'SATHI' appears below in slightly smaller matching green text. Clean, minimal, high-contrast layout conveying housing/shelter theme.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Android App Launcher Icon
nodes.description: Android launcher icon (representative of hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi density variants — all identical in design). Displays the AshaSathi wordmark logo — 'ASHA' in large bold green capitals with a house/roof icon integrated into the 'H', and 'SATHI' below — on a soft gradient background transitioning from very pale mint-green/white in the top-left to slightly richer mint toward the bottom-right. Rounded-square format typical of Android adaptive icons.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Main App Icon (AshaIcon)
nodes.description: High-resolution version of the AshaSathi app icon used as an asset within the Flutter project. Shows the full AshaSathi wordmark — 'ASHA' in bold green with a house/roof logomark on the 'H', 'SATHI' below — on a soft pale-mint gradient rounded-square background. This is the canonical asset-quality icon for in-app usage and store listings.

nodes.label: GitHub Social Login Button Icon
nodes.description: Official GitHub Octocat logo mark in solid black on a white/transparent background. The Octocat (cat-octopus hybrid mascot) is shown in a circular composition — white silhouette against a solid black circle. Standard icon used for 'Sign in with GitHub' OAuth login buttons. Monochrome, high-contrast design.

nodes.label: Google Social Login Button Icon
nodes.description: Official Google 'G' logo in the standard four-color scheme. A stylized capital 'G' formed by a segmented arc using Google brand colors: red (#EA4335) at the top, yellow (#FBBC05) at the bottom-left, green (#34A853) at the bottom, and blue (#4285F4) at the right. White center and background. Used for 'Sign in with Google' OAuth login buttons.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Flutter Splash Screen (splash1)
nodes.description: Flutter in-app splash screen asset showing the AshaSathi brand logo on a white background with generous padding. Visually very similar to the Android drawable splash — bold green 'ASHA' text with integrated house/roof icon on the 'H', and 'SATHI' in matching green below. The composition appears slightly larger/more padded than the Android version, suited for full-screen splash display within the Flutter app.

hyperedges.label: AshaSathi Brand Identity Assets
hyperedges.note: All four assets share the same visual brand: bold green AshaSathi wordmark with integrated house/roof icon on the H letterform, consistent color palette of deep green on white/light-mint background. The house icon symbolizes housing/shelter, aligning with the app's apparent purpose as a housing or community support platform.

hyperedges.label: Social OAuth Login Button Icons
hyperedges.note: GitHub and Google icons are standard OAuth provider logos used for third-party authentication flows within the AshaSathi Flutter app.
